prompts.prompt: A red ceramic teapot on a pale wooden table beside a small blue cup, soft morning window light, realistic product photograph.

A carefully arranged still life on a pale wooden kitchen table beside a north-facing window. A glossy red ceramic teapot sits in the center, its curved spout pointing to the right. A small matte blue cup rests beside it on a white saucer. Behind them are a folded cream linen napkin, three green pears in a shallow woven basket, and a clear glass vase holding two yellow flowers. Soft morning light casts gentle shadows toward the lower left. In the background, a light gray plaster wall and a dark wooden shelf remain slightly out of focus. Natural colors, detailed ceramic reflections, realistic materials, a calm and balanced composition, eye-level product photography, no people.
一张奶油色背景的简洁中文咖啡店海报。海报上方写着清晰的大字“周末咖啡”，下方写着“慢慢喝，慢慢聊”。中央是一杯棕色咖啡，放在深蓝色圆形杯碟上，旁边有一小块金黄色蛋糕。文字排列整齐，留白充足，平面插画风格。

output_contract.numeric_comparison: Compare decoded RGB and alpha separately; retain original PNGs. No alpha loss through RGB-only conversion.
output_contract.scope: Only native SGLang and native Omni; fallback is unsupported evidence.

quality_gate.visual: Inspect actual outputs and editing fidelity, Chinese glyphs, geometry and transparency; retain every failure.
